name: nop-message-encapsulation
description: Audit and fix the Kafka / Pulsar implementations of the nop-message abstraction. The SPI (IMessageService) is sound and must not be rewritten; the defects are in the two broker backends, where SPI option fields are silently ignored or diverge in semantics. Phase A establishes the audit baseline, the field-by-backend capability matrix, eleven pre-adjudicated design decisions (D1-D11), and a shared broker-neutral contract test. Phase B clears all silent violations (P0), including the Pulsar request-reply channel being entirely broken because getAckTopic prefixes Pulsar fully-qualified topic names, and Kafka SeekMode being a no-op before the first poll. Phase C fixes lifecycle and reliability (threads, bounded shutdown, destroy ordering, cancel idempotency, layered DLQ). Phase D aligns the envelope/metadata contract, batch arity, concurrency semantics, and error-code prefixes. Phase E adds observability and gated real-broker E2E. Phase F writes the owner doc and runs an independent closure audit. NOTE: commands.lint is scoped to nop-message because check-silent-wrong-result.mjs and check-import-order.mjs currently exit 1 on pre-existing repo-wide debt; WI18 of the roadmap is responsible for adding baseline or module scoping so those gates become usable. commands.typecheck currently exits 1 on pre-existing broken links outside nop-message.
